messages:
maria: Hey team — after upgrading our app to the latest Python SDK (redwood 1.31.0) we started seeing a flood of auth refreshes and 429s. POST /v1/token repeats every ~9s and our billing spike doubled. Anyone seen this?

alex: Sorry to hear that. Can you share the exact package version + how you create the client? Any small repro or logs?

maria: pip show redwood -> Version: 1.31.0
Code: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'], session_refresh=10)  # we expect 10 minutes
```
Logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-01T16:02:11Z INFO token_refresh POST /v1/token 200 (latency=120ms)
2026-03-01T16:02:20Z INFO token_refresh POST /v1/token 200 (latency=110ms)
2026-03-01T16:02:29Z INFO token_refresh POST /v1/token 200 (latency=130ms)
```

alex: Hmm that looks like a refresh interval of ~9s instead of minutes. Did you set any env vars like REDWOOD_SESSION_REFRESH_*?

maria: No env vars. We upgraded the wheel and kept the same instantiation. Quick repro script I ran locally:```python
import time
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key='x', session_refresh=10)
while True:
    time.sleep(5)
```
Then I tail the auth proxy and see repeated token requests every ~10s.

alex: Tagging runtime: @emma — looks like unit mismatch?

emma: Confirmed — regression introduced in 1.31.0. During an internal refactor the `session_refresh` parameter semantics accidentally changed from minutes to seconds. So apps passing `session_refresh=10` now refresh every 10s instead of 10 minutes, causing refresh loops, extra requests, occasional 429s and unexpected cost.

emma: Short-term workarounds: 1) Pin to 1.30.4: `pip install redwood==1.30.4` 2) Explicitly pass the new explicit arg: `session_refresh_seconds=600` or set env `REDWOOD_SESSION_REFRESH_SECONDS=600`. 3) If you rely on minutes semantics, pass `session_refresh_minutes=10` (compat shim).

jordan: If you saw duplicate charges please open a billing ticket with trace IDs — we can credit or reconcile. For others: pinning to 1.30.4 confirmed to stop the loop in our internal tests.

maria: Pin to 1.30.4 fixed it for us, thanks. Rolling back in prod now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: release redwood-python 1.31.1 created (cherry-pick revert of session_refresh unit change)

emma: We merged a patch and will publish 1.31.1 within 24 hours with a changelog entry and upgrade note. Apologies for the disruption — we'll add stricter tests for unit/semantic changes.

maria: Appreciate the fast response. Leaving thread in case others hit the same.
